checks: A newly published build immediately prompts on focus without reloading or changing an active workout
Functional update prompt fits phone and desktop sizes in the existing light/dark theme
Later dismisses only this release; the update remains available in Settings
Offline update requests keep the working app open and preserve its journal
Reconnection detects a newer build even when its version number is unchanged and the previous notice was dismissed
A failed autosave blocks loading an update until the change is saved successfully
One Load update click flushes pending set writes and opens the actual newest release, not the older prompt target
Settings Update app rechecks and reloads the latest release even when already up to date
A corrupt or partial release fails verification without deleting the working offline cache
The previous complete app and unchanged workout remain usable after a failed update
Preview updates use only their own release, writer lock, data and cache while production remains open
Production records survive preview updates and no uncaught app exceptions occur
A foreground session detects a release on its real polling timer without a focus event or automatic reload
